title: Charitable subscriptions and reliance
summary: The charitable-pledge materials separate bargained-for duties, actual reliance, and the second Restatement’s special provision.
notes: Allegheny College finds an implied undertaking associated with a named memorial fund and is treated as a consideration case despite its important estoppel discussion. The first § 90 formulation required definite and substantial induced conduct. The second adds a provision for charitable subscriptions and marriage settlements without proof that the promise induced action or forbearance. The book’s decisions and questions do not establish uniform state adoption of that exception.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 124–130. Open assigned page 124.
